findings.title: Incorrect argument order in URLSafeTimedSerializer call
findings.body: The new `keys` argument is placed before the `app.secret_key` positional argument in the `URLSafeTimedSerializer` constructor call. The constructor expects `secret_key` as the first positional argument, so this will raise a `TypeError` at runtime. Pass `keys` as a keyword argument to maintain the correct order.
findings.suggestion:
app.secret_key,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            keys,  # type: ignore[arg-type]

findings.title: Inconsistent signer_kwargs construction style
findings.body: The new `signer_kwargs` is constructed as a dictionary literal, while the old code used `dict(...)`. The surrounding codebase consistently uses the `dict(...)` constructor for such cases. Align the style to maintain consistency.

summary.problem: The secret key rotation change introduces a runtime error due to incorrect argument order and reduces readability through inconsistent style.
summary.done_well: The implementation adds support for fallback secret keys, improving security posture.
